name: Pusillin and the Elder Azj'Tordin
label: Quest
description: Pusillin and the Elder Azj'Tordin: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I had let my guard down for only one moment, stranger. In my haste to escape the grip of the fallen Prince, I was robbed. A most foul demon, the imp Pusillin, pilfered my book of incantations and the key to the once great halls of Eldre'Thalas.
I no longer hold interest in the key, as I have exchanged my immortality for freedom, but I desperately need my book of incantations.
Find the imp, Pusillin, and recover my book.
Search the Warpwood Quarter of Dire Maul for Pusillin.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I regret nothing, stranger. The Queen has long since passed. The works of the Shen'Dralar have been marred by the madness of Prince Tortheldrin. I seek only freedom... Escape...

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have found it! A curse upon that miserable imp. Alas, my material possessions are meager at best. You may choose from what I have to offer.
